purpose: Attach locally loaded frozen FP32 CNN morphology observations to runtime-scan-001 candidates without emitting candidate, path, probability, confidence, or policy data.

input.model_artifact: local cnn-export-003 ONNX model and manifest with checksum, class-order, graph, shape, and preprocessing validation

aggregate_fields: primary-class count for sensitive_like, placeholder_or_test, benign_other

boundaries: no raw candidate, source path, context, fingerprint, logits, probabilities, or confidence in output
no persistence, telemetry, remote access, remote model download, or runtime network
observation is not calibration, fusion, a policy decision, or a validity assertion
any local model or scanner error is returned as a sanitized CLI failure
